messages:
customer-acme: Hey team — after our IdP cert rotation this morning about half our users get a 403 when they try to SSO into the app. Happens for both Chrome and Safari. We see a SAMLResponse validation error in our logs. Repro steps: 1) Click company SSO button 2) Get redirected to IdP 3) Redirect back to /saml/acs -> 403.

irene (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact error from your ACS logs? Any recent infra changes besides the IdP rotation?

customer-acme: Log snippet: `SAML validation failed: recipient mismatch; expected https://app.acme.com/saml/acs but got http://10.2.5.11/saml/acs`
Also noticed `X-Forwarded-Proto: http` in the request headers coming into our ACS service (we terminate TLS at the edge LB). We didn't touch our LB config.

irene (Support): Hmm, that "got http://10.2.5.11" looks like an internal host/addr is surfacing. Quick check: are you running any proxy that rewrites Host or scheme before requests hit the ACS endpoint?

customer-acme: We have an internal proxy cluster that sends traffic to Kubernetes pods. It should set `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` but the pod is seeing `http`. Could this be because the IdP is posting directly to the external LB which then proxies?

ashwin (Eng): Jumping in — recipient mismatch typically means the SAML assertion's Recipient/AssertionConsumerService value doesn't match the ACS URL the SP validates. If the proxy is rewriting the Host or stripping X-Forwarded-Proto, the SP may reconstruct a URL with the internal proto/host. That would cause the check to fail.

sam (Oncall): I also see a deploy-bot event at 1712349800 showing an auto cert rotation on the IdP side: `deploy-bot: idp-cert-rotation job succeeded for acme-idp (thumbprint a3:4c:...)`. Could be correlated.

customer-acme: We tried re-running the request with curl from the edge LB and saw `Location: https://app.acme.com/saml/acs` from IdP, but when it lands on the pod the app logs show `http://10.2.5.11`. So yes, the scheme/host is changing in transit.

ashwin (Eng): Short repro commands that helped me locally: `curl -v -H \"Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\" --data \"SAMLResponse=<...>\" https://app.acme.com/saml/acs` -> server logs show resolved_request_url = `https://app.acme.com/saml/acs`. Then send the same POST to the LB's backend IP (simulate proxy) without X-Forwarded-Proto -> server logs show `http://10.2.5.11/saml/acs` and SAML check fails.

ashwin (Eng): Root cause hypothesis: after IdP rotation the SAMLResponse has the same Recipient but our SP runtime bases validation on the request's reconstructed ACS URL. If the proxy terminates TLS and doesn't forward `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` (or the SP doesn't honor it), the reconstructed URL becomes http+internal-host and validation fails. The timing with cert rotation is probably coincidental or exposed the latent proxy config problem.

irene (Support): Recommended quick workaround: configure the proxy/LB to preserve `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` and `X-Forwarded-Host` / Host header, or configure the SP to use a canonical ACS URL override rather than inferring from the incoming request. Which option is faster for you?

customer-acme: We can flip the LB to preserve proto/host within ~15 minutes. Will that be enough?

ashwin (Eng): Yes, preserving X-Forwarded-Proto and Host should make the reconstructed ACS match the IdP Recipient. Also check that there isn't any internal rewrite rule that replaces hostnames with pod IPs.

sam (Oncall): I'm scheduling a quick change window and will apply a header passthrough at the edge. I can watch logs while you attempt an SSO.

deploy-bot: idp-cert-rotation job succeeded for acme-idp at 1712349800 (automated).

customer-acme: Patch applied at 1712349990 — LB now forwards `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` and preserves Host. Trying SSO now...

customer-acme: Success — users can login again. No 403s observed. Thanks.

irene (Support): Great. We'll keep this ticket open for a follow-up: please consider making the SP config use a fixed `assertion_consumer_service_url` in the SP metadata so it doesn't rely on reconstructed values.

ashwin (Eng): Filing a small internal note: svc/saml-sp should accept canonicalization config and prefer `X-Forwarded-*` only when enabled. I'll put up a PR for a config flag to avoid future surprises.

customer-acme: Thanks all — want to confirm whether we need to rotate anything on our IdP after this change?

ashwin (Eng): No further IdP rotation needed. The SAML assertions were valid; they just hit a host/scheme rewrite. Closing loop: cause=proxy header drop; mitigation=preserve X-Forwarded-Proto/Host; long-term=SP canonical ACS override + runtime config flag.

irene (Support): Marking resolved, will follow up with a KB article on this class of recipient-mismatch problems. :white_check_mark:
